description: Install a theme from a ZIP, either a public URL (url, must end in .zip) or a local file (file_path, absolute path to a .zip, max 64 MB). Give exactly one of them. file_path uploads the file from this machine, so it works for private or locally built themes; it needs cvrt-mcp-endpoints >= 1.20.0 on the site. Replacing the ACTIVE theme additionally needs replace_active: true (replaces the live theme; a theme with broken PHP takes the site down). url keeps working on older versions, but has no GitHub token support: private release assets cannot be installed that way.

activate.description: Switch to the theme after install (default false)

file_path.description: Absolute local path to a theme .zip to upload (max 64 MB). Not together with url.

overwrite.description: Replace the theme folder if it already exists (default true). The ACTIVE theme is only replaced when replace_active is also true.

replace_active.description: Allow replacing the ACTIVE theme (default false; without it the site answers 409 active_theme). Replaces the live theme: a theme with broken PHP takes the site down. cvrt-mcp-endpoints >= 1.20.0.

url.description: URL to the theme ZIP file (must end in .zip). Not together with file_path.

name: mcp_install_theme_zip
